bleed.about: Flush to the parent's edge; the parent supplies the corners and clips.

seed.about: 1-6. Deterministic, so two screenshots of the same slot match.

stock.about: When true, fill with a stand-in photograph (by seed) instead of drawing one.

src.about: Explicit image URL/path; overrides seed and category.

category.about: What this plate stands in for — "storefront", "dunes", "prep bench". Resolves through STOCK_BY_CATEGORY when an application has registered a manifest, and names the subject on the plate's own label wh

subject.about: Who the plate draws. "person" draws a head and shoulders in silhouette, for a portrait, a bio, a speaker or a directory entry, in place of the light and horizon a plate otherwise draws. Give it a tall

placement.about: Stock honesty: quiet whisper (default), loud legacy, or hidden.

priority.about: Mark the one plate that is visible before any scrolling. A plate's photograph is usually the largest thing on the screen, which makes it the Largest Contentful Paint. Everything here defers by default

fx.about: Motion FX. `true` infers plate / plate-stock / plate-hero from stock+bleed.
